en.s: The Battle of Brouwershaven was fought on 13 January 1426 in Brouwershaven, Zeeland. The battle was part of the Hook and Cod wars waged over control of the Low Countries and resulted in a significant victory for Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy.

en.t: Sicut Dudum, forbidding the enslavement by the Spanish of the Guanche natives in Canary Islands who had converted, or were converting to, Christianity, is promulgated by Pope Eugene IV
en.s: Sicut dudum (from Latin: "Just as Long Ago") was a papal bull promulgated by Pope Eugene IV in Florence on January 13, 1435, which forbade the enslavement of the Indigenous Guanches people of the Canary Islands who had converted, or were converting to, Christianity and ordered, under pain of excommunication, that all such slaves be set free within 15 days.

zh.s: 1435年1月13日，教宗尤金四世在佛罗伦萨颁布《Sicut dudum》诏书，禁止奴役加那利群岛已经或正在皈依基督教的关切原住民，并命令在15天内释放所有符合这一条件的被奴役者，违者将被绝罚。诏书拉丁文名称意为“正如很久以前”。

en.s: The siege of Wiener Neustad, part of the Austrian–Hungarian War, was an assault from January 1486 to August 1487 on the Austrian town of Wiener Neustadt. Launched by Matthias Corvinus, King of Hungary, the 18-month siege ended with the town's surrender and allowed Hungary to take control of the surrounding regions of Styria and Lower Austria.

en.t: Henry Howard, Earl of Surrey, sentenced to death
en.s: Henry Howard, Earl of Surrey, was sentenced to death on 13 January 1547 on a charge of treason associated with his use of royal heraldic arms. He was executed on 19 January 1547. The sentence and execution were separate events.

zh.t: 萨里伯爵亨利·霍华德被判死刑
zh.s: 1547年1月13日，萨里伯爵亨利·霍华德因使用王室纹章所涉的叛国指控而被判处死刑。他于同年1月19日被处决，判刑与行刑是两个不同日期的事件。

en.s: The siege of Gvozdansko (Croatian: Opsada Gvozdanskog) was an Ottoman siege of the fort of Gvozdansko in the Kingdom of Croatia in 1577–1578. In the 1570s, the Ottomans intensified their efforts to capture the valley of the Una River. A string of forts along the Una, centred around Gvozdansko and in possession of the Zrinski noble family, formed the main line of defense of Croatia since 1527.

A British force of over 3,000 troops, supported by 19,000 bullocks, had run out of supplies during a slow march over the Ghats which was aimed at joining with another force coming from Bengal.

en.s: The action of 13 January 1797 (known by the French as the Naufrage du Droits de l'Homme; "shipwreck [or sinking] of the Droits de l'Homme") was a minor naval battle fought between a French ship of the line and two British frigates off the coast of Brittany during the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 1797年1月13日，法国大革命战争期间，一艘法国战列舰与两艘英国护卫舰在布列塔尼近海交战。这是一场规模较小的海战，法方称其为“人权号沉没事件”。

en.s: The Battle of Uclés (13 January 1809) saw an Imperial French corps led by Marshal Claude Perrin Victor attack a Spanish force under Francisco Javier Venegas. The French easily crushed their outnumbered foes, capturing over half of the Spanish infantry. Uclés is located in the province of Cuenca 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) east of Tarancón and 100 kilometres (62 mi) southeast of Madrid. The action occurred during what is called the Peninsular War in English-speaking countries and the Spanish War of Independence in Spain. The war was part of a larger struggle known as the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1809年1月13日，克洛德·佩兰·维克托元帅率领法国帝国军一支军团，进攻弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·贝内加斯指挥的西班牙部队。法军轻易击溃人数较少的对手，俘获超过一半的西班牙步兵。乌克莱斯位于昆卡省，在塔兰孔以东15公里、马德里东南100公里。此战属于英语国家所称的半岛战争，在西班牙则称独立战争，也是规模更大的拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Lankaran (Persian: محاصره لنکران; Russian: Штурм Ленкорани) took place from 7 January to 13 January 1813 during the Russo-Persian War (1804–1813). Lankaran, a city in the Talish region, was previously held by Mir-Mostafa Khan of the Talysh Khanate, a subject of Iran. However, due to his defiance, he was ousted from the city by Iranian forces in August 1812.

en.s: The Battle of Fort Point Peter was a successful attack in early 1815 by a British force on a smaller American force on the Georgia side of the St. Marys River near St. Marys, Georgia. The river was then part of the international border between the United States and British-allied Spanish Florida; it now forms part of the boundary between Georgia and Florida.

en.s: The Battle of Almolonga was a military action during the First Mexican Empire on January 13, 1823 in the town of Almolonga, between the hills of Teposteyo and Ahuacopexco, in the state of Guerrero during the revolution in favor of the Veracruz Plan in order to put an end to the Mexican Empire.

zh.s: 1823年1月13日，墨西哥第一帝国时期的阿尔莫隆加战役在格雷罗州阿尔莫隆加镇、特波斯特约与阿瓦科佩斯科两座山丘之间展开。这次军事行动属于支持《韦拉克鲁斯计划》、旨在终结墨西哥帝国的革命。

en.s: The Battle of Gandamak on 13 January 1842 was a defeat of British forces by Afghan tribesmen in the 1842 retreat from Kabul of General Elphinstone's army, during which the last survivors of the force—twenty officers and forty-five British soldiers of the 44th East Essex Regiment—were killed.

zh.s: 1842年1月13日，英军在甘达马克被阿富汗部落战士击败。这是埃尔芬斯通将军所部从喀布尔撤退过程中的一战，该部最后幸存的20名军官及第44东埃塞克斯团45名英国士兵在战斗中被杀。

en.s: The 1842 retreat from Kabul was the retreat of the British and East India Company forces from Kabul during the First Anglo-Afghan War. An uprising in Kabul forced the then-commander, Major-General William Elphinstone, to fall back to the British garrison at Jalalabad. In early January 1842, as the army and its numerous dependants and camp followers began their march, they came under attack from Afghan tribesmen.

en.s: The Treaty of Cahuenga, also called the "Capitulation of Cahuenga," ended the fighting of the Mexican-American War in Alta California in 1847. It was not a formal treaty between nations but an informal agreement between rival military forces in which the Californios gave up fighting. The treaty was drafted in English and Spanish by José Antonio Carrillo, approved by American Lieutenant-Colonel John C. Frémont and Mexican Governor Andrés Pico on January 13, 1847 at Campo de Cahuenga in what is now North Hollywood, Los Angeles, California. The treaty called for the Californios to give up their artillery, and provided that all prisoners from both sides be immediately freed.

zh.t: 《卡温加协议》结束上加利福尼亚的美墨战争战斗
zh.s: 1847年1月13日，《卡温加协议》，又称《卡温加投降协议》，结束美墨战争在上加利福尼亚的战斗。它并非国家间正式条约，而是交战军队之间的非正式协议，加利福尼亚的墨西哥裔居民据此停止抵抗。何塞·安东尼奥·卡里略以英西双语起草协议，美国中校约翰·C.弗里蒙特与墨西哥总督安德烈斯·皮科，在今洛杉矶北好莱坞的卡温加营地批准。协议要求加利福尼亚一方交出火炮，双方所有俘虏立即释放。

en.s: The Battle of Nyárasd was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 13 January 1849 between a detachment of the Hungarian Garrison of Komárom led by Colonel Ferdinand Querlonde du Hammel against part of the besieging troops of the Austrian Empire, led by Lieutenant-Colonel Gustav Freiherr von Geramb. The Hungarians defeated the Austrians, putting them to flight, and killing Lieutenant-Colonel Geramb.

zh.s: 1849年1月13日，匈牙利独立战争中的尼亚拉什德战役爆发。费迪南德·凯隆德·迪阿梅尔上校率科马罗姆驻军的一支分队，迎战古斯塔夫·冯·格拉姆男爵中校指挥的部分奥地利围城部队。匈牙利军击败奥军并使其溃逃，格拉姆中校阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Chillianwala (also spelled Chillianwallah) was fought in January 1849 during the Second Anglo-Sikh War in the Chillianwala region (Mandi Bahauddin) of Punjab, now part of Pakistan. The battle was one of the bloodiest fought by the British East India Company. Both armies held their positions at the end of the battle and both sides claimed victory.

zh.s: 1849年1月，第二次英锡战争期间，英军与锡克军队在旁遮普的奇利安瓦拉地区交战，地点位于今巴基斯坦曼迪巴哈丁一带。这是英国东印度公司所经历的最血腥战役之一。战斗结束时，双方均守住阵地，并都宣称获胜。

en.t: Establishment of the Colony of Vancouver Island
en.s: The Colony of Vancouver Island was established on 13 January 1849 as a British Crown colony. It included Vancouver Island and the nearby Gulf Islands. In 1866 it merged with the mainland Colony of British Columbia, before the united colony joined Canada in 1871.

zh.s: 1849年1月13日，英国建立温哥华岛王室殖民地，范围包括温哥华岛及附近的海湾群岛。1866年，该殖民地与大陆上的不列颠哥伦比亚殖民地合并，合并后的殖民地于1871年加入加拿大。

en.s: The Lister Expedition was a punitive expedition in 1850 against Lushai chiefs such as Ngûra who raided Cachar. It is referred to as the Lister Expedition, which was headed by Colonel Frederick George Lister.

en.s: On January 13, 1888, 33 explorers and scientists met at the Cosmos Club in Washington, D.C., to organise a society for the advancement and diffusion of geographical knowledge. en.s: The 1903 Yukon general election was held on January 13, 1903. The council was expanded to elect five of the ten members to the Yukon Territorial Council. The election was fought along party lines even though the council was limited in its powers and played an advisory role to the federally appointed Commissioner.

zh.s: 1903年1月13日，育空地区举行选举，地区议会扩大民选席位，由选举产生10名议员中的5名。虽然议会权力有限，主要向联邦任命的专员提供咨询，各方仍沿着政党界线展开竞选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 13 January 1907. Divisional General Fernando Figueroa was elected with 99.76 percent of the vote. His closest rival Luis Alonso Barahona received 222 votes to Figueroa's 152,053.

zh.s: 1907年1月13日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举。师级将军费尔南多·菲格罗亚以99.76%的得票率当选，获得152,053票。得票第二的路易斯·阿隆索·巴拉奥纳仅获222票。

en.s: The Rhoads Opera House Fire occurred on Monday evening, January 13, 1908 in Boyertown, Pennsylvania. The opera house caught fire during a stage play sponsored by nearby St. John's Lutheran Church. The fire started when a kerosene lamp being used for stage lighting was knocked over starting a fire on the stage. In short order the spreading fire ignited a mixture of lighting gas & oxygen from a malfunctioning stereopticon machine being used to present a magic lantern show at intermission. Audience members waited for the fire to be extinguished by theatre personnel, wasting the precious minutes they needed to escape safely.

zh.s: 1908年1月13日星期一晚，美国宾夕法尼亚州博耶敦的罗兹歌剧院发生火灾。当时附近圣约翰路德教会资助的舞台剧正在演出。一盏用于舞台照明的煤油灯被碰倒，引燃舞台；火势很快又点燃一台故障幻灯放映机泄出的照明气与氧气混合物，该机器原用于中场休息时放映幻灯。观众等待剧院人员灭火，错过了安全逃生所需的宝贵时间。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1914 occurred on Tuesday, January 13, 1914. James Michael Curley, member of the United States House of Representatives, was elected Mayor of Boston for the first time, defeating Thomas J. Kenny, president of the Boston City Council. Incumbent mayor John F. Fitzgerald withdrew in December, citing illness; in actuality, Curley and attorney Daniel H.

zh.s: 1914年1月13日星期二，波士顿举行市长选举。联邦众议员詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利击败市议会议长托马斯·J.肯尼，首次当选市长。现任市长约翰·F.菲茨杰拉德于12月以生病为由退出。原文接着说明实际原因，但在写到柯利与律师“丹尼尔·H.”处中断。

en.t: About 30,000 people were killed when an earthquake struck the Province of L'Aquila in Italy
en.s: The 1915 Avezzano earthquake or 1915 Fucino earthquake occurred on 13 January in central Italy at 07:52:42 local time. The shock had a moment magnitude of 6.7 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme). The epicenter was located in the city of Avezzano (which was destroyed) in the Province of L'Aquila. Around 30,000 direct fatalities and $60 million in damage resulted from the earthquake.

zh.s: 1915年1月13日当地时间07时52分42秒，意大利中部发生矩震级6.7级地震，最大烈度达麦加利地震烈度表XI级，即“极其强烈”。震中位于拉奎拉省阿韦扎诺市，该市遭到毁坏。地震直接造成约3万人死亡，损失约6000万美元。

en.s: The Battle of Wadi, occurring on 13 January 1916, was an unsuccessful attempt by British forces fighting in Mesopotamia (present-day Iraq) during World War I to relieve beleaguered forces under Sir Charles Townshend then under siege by the Ottoman Sixth Army at Kut-al-Amara. Pushed by regional British Commander-in-Chief Sir John Nixon, General Fenton Aylmer launched an attack against Ottoman defensive positions on the banks of the Wadi River. The Wadi was a steep valley of a stream that ran from the north into the River Tigris, some 6 miles (9.7 km) upstream towards Kut-al-Amara from Sheikh Sa'ad.

zh.s: 1916年1月13日，第一次世界大战中驻美索不达米亚，今伊拉克，的英军试图为库特的守军解围，但未成功。查尔斯·汤森德爵士率领的部队当时被奥斯曼第六集团军围困。在英军当地总司令约翰·尼克松爵士催促下，芬顿·艾尔默将军进攻瓦迪河岸的奥斯曼防御阵地。瓦迪是一条自北向南注入底格里斯河的溪流所在的陡峭河谷，位于谢赫萨阿德向库特方向上游约六英里、即9.7公里处。

en.s: A referendum on territorial status was held in the Territory of the Saar Basin on 13 January 1935. Over 90% of voters opted for reunification with Germany, with 9% voting for the status quo as a League of Nations mandate territory and less than 0.5% opting for unification with France.

zh.s: 1935年1月13日，萨尔盆地地区举行领土地位公投。超过90%的选民选择重新并入德国，约9%支持维持国际联盟托管地的现状，不足0.5%选择并入法国。

en.s: The 1936 Hong Kong municipal election was supposed to be held on 13 January 1936 for the one of the 2 unofficial seats in the Urban Council of Hong Kong. It was supposed to be the first election after the Sanitary Board was reconstituted into the Urban Council. Dr. Chau Sik-nin, who later became the Senior Unofficial Member of the Executive and Legislative Council, was elected without being contested.

zh.s: 1936年香港市政选举原定于1月13日举行，改选市政局两个非官守议席中的一个。这原本将是洁净局改组为市政局后的首次选举，但周锡年医生因无人竞争而直接当选。他后来成为行政局及立法局的首席非官守议员。

en.s: The Black Friday bushfires of 13 January 1939, in Victoria, Australia, were part of the 1938–1939 bushfire season in Australia, which saw bushfires burning for the whole summer, and ash falling as far away as New Zealand. It was calculated that three-quarters of the State of Victoria was directly or indirectly affected by the disaster, while other Australian states and the Australian Capital Territory were also badly hit by fires and extreme heat.

zh.t: 澳大利亚“黑色星期五”丛林大火
zh.s: 1939年1月13日，澳大利亚维多利亚州发生“黑色星期五”丛林大火。这是1938—1939年丛林火灾季的一部分：大火持续整个夏季，灰烬甚至飘到新西兰。据估算，维多利亚州四分之三的地区直接或间接受灾，其他州及澳大利亚首都领地也遭遇严重火灾与极端高温。

en.s: The Ostrogozhsk–Rossosh offensive (Russian: Острогожско-Россошанская операция) was an offensive of the Voronezh Front on the Eastern Front of World War II against the Hungarian 2nd Army and parts of the Italian 8th Army as part of the Voronezh–Kharkov offensive. The offensive came after Operation Little Saturn, made in support of the Stalingrad encirclement.

zh.t: 奥斯特罗戈日斯克—罗索什攻势
zh.s: 第二次世界大战东线战场上，苏军沃罗涅日方面军向匈牙利第二集团军及意大利第八集团军的部分部队发动奥斯特罗戈日斯克—罗索什攻势，作为沃罗涅日—哈尔科夫攻势的一部分。此前，苏军已发动小土星行动，以支援对斯大林格勒的包围。

en.t: First Indochina War: The Battle of Vĩnh Yên begins
en.s: The Battle of Vĩnh Yên (Vietnamese: Trận Vĩnh Yên) which occurred from 13 to 17 January 1951, was a major engagement in the First Indochina War between the French Union and the communist Việt Minh. The French Union forces, including the French Armed Forces and Vietnamese National Army, led by World War II hero Jean de Lattre de Tassigny, inflicted a decisive defeat on the Việt Minh forces, which were commanded by Võ Nguyên Giáp.

zh.s: 1951年1月13日至17日，法国联盟军与越盟在永安展开激战，这是第一次印度支那战争中的一场重要战役。让·德·拉特尔·德·塔西尼率领包括法国军队与越南国军在内的法联军，重创武元甲指挥的越盟部队。

en.s: The 1963 Togolese coup d'état was a military coup that occurred in the country of Togo on 13 January 1963. The coup leaders (notably Emmanuel Bodjolle, Étienne Eyadéma and Kléber Dadjo) took over government buildings, arrested most of the cabinet, and assassinated Togo's first President, Sylvanus Olympio outside the American embassy in Lomé. The coup leaders quickly brought Nicolas Grunitzky and Antoine Meatchi, both of whom were exiled political opponents of Olympio, together to form a new government. While the government of Ghana and its President Kwame Nkrumah were implicated in the coup and assassination of Olympio, full investigation was never completed and the international outcry eventually died down.

zh.s: 1963年1月13日，多哥发生军事政变。政变领导人主要包括埃马纽埃尔·博乔莱、艾蒂安·埃亚德马及克莱贝尔·达乔。他们占领政府建筑，逮捕大多数内阁成员，并在洛美美国使馆外杀害多哥首任总统西尔瓦努斯·奥林匹奥。政变者很快召回流亡海外的两名奥林匹奥政敌——尼古拉·格鲁尼茨基和安托万·梅阿奇——共同组建新政府。加纳政府及总统夸梅·恩克鲁玛被指牵涉政变和暗杀，但全面调查始终未完成，国际社会的谴责也逐渐平息。

en.s: The 1967 Togolese coup d'état was a bloodless military coup that occurred in the West African country of Togo on 13 January 1967. The leader of the coup, Lieutenant Colonel Étienne Eyadéma (later General Gnassingbé Eyadéma) ousted Togo's second President, Nicolas Grunitzky, whom he essentially brought to power following the 1963 coup d'état. Following the coup, political parties were banned, and all constitutional processes were suspended.

zh.s: 1967年1月13日，西非国家多哥发生不流血军事政变。艾蒂安·埃亚德马中校，后来的纳辛贝·埃亚德马将军，推翻该国第二任总统尼古拉·格鲁尼茨基。格鲁尼茨基本就是他在1963年政变后扶上台的。政变之后，政党被禁止活动，一切宪政程序被暂停。

en.s: Japan Air Lines Cargo Flight 1045 was a charter flight on January 13, 1977, from Grant County, Washington, to Tokyo, Japan, with a stopover in Anchorage, Alaska. The McDonnell Douglas DC-8-62AF operating the flight crashed during the initial climb shortly after takeoff from Anchorage, in part because the captain, Hugh L. Marsh, was intoxicated as shown by a blood alcohol level of 0.29; the co-pilot and the other crew were not impaired.

zh.t: 日本航空货运1045号班机空难
zh.s: 1977年1月13日，日本航空货运1045号包机从美国华盛顿州格兰特县飞往日本东京，经停阿拉斯加州安克雷奇。执飞的麦道DC-8-62AF在安克雷奇起飞不久、初始爬升阶段坠毁。部分原因是机长休·L.马什醉酒，血液酒精水平达0.29；副驾驶及其他机组人员未受酒精影响。

en.s: Air Florida Flight 90 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated from Washington National Airport (now Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport) to Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International Airport, with an intermediate stopover at Tampa International Airport, that crashed into the 14th Street Bridge over the Potomac River just after takeoff from Washington National Airport on January 13, 1982.

zh.t: 佛罗里达航空90号班机空难
zh.s: 1982年1月13日，佛罗里达航空90号班机从华盛顿国家机场，今罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场，起飞后不久，撞上横跨波托马克河的第十四街大桥。这是飞往劳德代尔堡—好莱坞国际机场、途中经停坦帕国际机场的定期国内客运航班。

en.s: On 13 January 1985, an express train derailed on a curved bridge over the gorge of the Awash River in Awash, Ethiopia. The official death toll was 428, with more than 500 injuries.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚阿瓦什铁路惨案
zh.s: 1985年1月13日，一列特快列车在埃塞俄比亚阿瓦什镇、横跨阿瓦什河峡谷的一座弯桥上脱轨。官方统计死亡428人，受伤超过500人。

en.t: Lee Teng-hui succeeds Chiang Ching-kuo as president
en.s: Lee Teng-hui succeeded Chiang Ching-kuo as president of the Republic of China on 13 January 1988 following Chiang’s death. This succession preceded Lee’s later election to the presidency by direct popular vote.

zh.s: 1988年1月13日，蒋经国去世后，李登辉继任中华民国总统。这次继任早于他后来通过全民直接投票当选总统。

en.t: Douglas Wilder takes office as governor of Virginia
en.s: Douglas Wilder was sworn in as governor of Virginia on January 13, 1990. He was the first African American elected governor of a U.S. state. His inauguration was distinct from the earlier election that brought him to office.

zh.t: 道格拉斯·怀尔德就任弗吉尼亚州州长
zh.s: 1990年1月13日，道格拉斯·怀尔德宣誓就任弗吉尼亚州州长。他是美国首位经选举产生的非裔州长。就职仪式与此前使他当选的选举是两个不同的事件。

en.s: The Portuguese presidential election of 1991 was held on 13 January. The re-election of the hugely popular Mário Soares was never in doubt, specially after the then-ruling PSD, led by Prime Minister Aníbal Cavaco Silva announced its support. Therefore, the election held on 13 January 1991 was a landslide, and no second round was needed. As the election of a left-wing candidate was assured, other left-wing parties, the Portuguese Communist Party and the People's Democratic Union, presented their own candidates. The communists presented Carlos Carvalhas, who had been Assistant General Secretary of the Party a year before (Álvaro Cunhal was the secretary-general).

zh.s: 1991年1月13日，葡萄牙举行总统选举。声望极高的马里奥·苏亚雷斯连任几乎没有悬念，尤其是在阿尼巴尔·卡瓦科·席尔瓦总理领导的执政党社会民主党宣布支持他之后。苏亚雷斯最终大胜，无须举行第二轮。由于左翼候选人获胜已成定局，其他左翼政党，包括葡萄牙共产党及人民民主联盟，也各自推出候选人。共产党提名卡洛斯·卡瓦利亚斯，他在前一年担任党的助理总书记，当时总书记为阿尔瓦罗·库尼亚尔。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Cape Verde on 13 January 1991, the country's first multi-party elections, having previously been a one-party state with the African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde (PAICV) as the sole legal party. The result was a victory for the Movement for Democracy, which won 56 of the 79 seats. Voter turnout was 75.3%.

zh.s: 1991年1月13日，佛得角举行首次多党议会选举。此前该国实行一党制，佛得角非洲独立党是唯一合法政党。争取民主运动赢得79席中的56席，取得胜利。投票率为75.3%。

en.s: The January Events (Lithuanian: Sausio įvykiai) were a series of violent confrontations between the civilian population of Lithuania, supporting independence, and the Soviet Armed Forces. The events took place between 11 and 13 January 1991, after the restoration of independence by Lithuania. As a result of the Soviet military actions, 14 civilians were killed and over 140 were injured as they peacefully protested for freedom in what is known as the Vilnius massacre.

zh.s: 1991年1月11日至13日，恢复独立后的立陶宛发生一系列暴力冲突，一方是支持独立的平民，另一方是苏联武装部队。苏军行动造成14名平民死亡、140多人受伤。这些平民当时正在为争取自由进行和平抗议，这场事件亦被称为“维尔纽斯惨案”。

en.s: STS-54 was a NASA Space Transportation System (Space Shuttle) mission using Space Shuttle Endeavour. This was the third flight for Endeavour, and was launched on January 13, 1993, with Endeavour returning to the Kennedy Space Center on January 19, 1993.

zh.s: 1993年1月13日，奋进号航天飞机执行美国国家航空航天局的STS-54任务升空。这是奋进号的第三次飞行。航天飞机于同年1月19日返回肯尼迪航天中心。

en.t: Chemical Weapons Convention opens for signature
en.s: The Chemical Weapons Convention opened for signature in Paris on 13 January 1993. The treaty prohibits the development, production, stockpiling and use of chemical weapons and provides for their destruction. It entered into force on 29 April 1997, a separate milestone from opening for signature.

zh.t: 《禁止化学武器公约》开放签署
zh.s: 1993年1月13日，《禁止化学武器公约》在巴黎开放签署。公约禁止发展、生产、储存和使用化学武器，并规定销毁化学武器。公约于1997年4月29日正式生效，开放签署与正式生效是两个不同的节点。

en.t: Opening of the January 1993 coalition airstrikes on Iraq
en.s: A series of coalition airstrikes against Iraq began on January 13, 1993, and continued until January 22. American, British and French forces acted in the context of the Iraqi no-fly zones conflict. The opening raid was part of Operation Southern Watch, which had begun in 1992.

zh.t: 1993年1月联军对伊拉克的空袭开始
zh.s: 1993年1月13日，联军开始对伊拉克发动一系列空袭，行动持续至1月22日。美国、英国和法国军队的行动发生在伊拉克禁飞区冲突背景下。首轮空袭属于“南方守望”行动的一部分，而该行动早在1992年就已开始。

en.s: The 1995 King Fahd Cup final was a football match to determine the winners of the 1995 King Fahd Cup. The match was held at King Fahd II Stadium, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on 13 January 1995 and was contested by Denmark and Argentina. Denmark won the match 2–0.

zh.s: 1995年1月13日，法赫德国王杯决赛在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的法赫德国王二世体育场举行，由丹麦对阵阿根廷。丹麦以2比0获胜，夺得本届冠军。

en.s: The 1999 Honduran Supercup was held between winners of 1997–98 Honduran Liga Nacional (Motagua) and 1997 Honduran Cup (Platense). It was the second attempt for the Selacios to obtain the crown, however, the Blues prevailed as champions.

zh.s: 1999年洪都拉斯超级杯由1997—1998赛季洪都拉斯全国联赛冠军莫塔瓜，对阵1997年洪都拉斯杯冠军普拉滕斯。这是绰号“鲨鱼”的普拉滕斯第二次争夺该奖杯，但最终由绰号“蓝军”的莫塔瓜夺冠。

en.s: The 2000 Marsa Brega Short 360 crash occurred on 13 January 2000 when a Swiss-registered Short 360 leased by Avisto ditched into the sea near Marsa Brega in Libya. The aircraft was chartered by Sirte Oil Company to transport oil workers to the city. It was carrying 41 people (38 passengers and three crew). Most of the passengers were foreigners. As both engines failed in mid-flight, the crew chose to ditch the aircraft. A total of 22 people died in the crash. An official investigation concluded that the de-icing device on the aircraft was not activated.

zh.t: 2000年利比亚布雷加港肖特360客机事故
zh.s: 2000年1月13日，一架由Avisto租用、在瑞士注册的肖特360客机，在利比亚布雷加港附近海上迫降。苏尔特石油公司包下这架飞机，运送石油工人前往该市。机上共41人，包括38名乘客及三名机组人员，多数乘客为外国人。飞行途中两台发动机均失效，机组决定海上迫降，最终22人死亡。官方调查认定，飞机的除冰装置没有开启。

en.s: The Battle for Argun (Russian: Битва за Аргун; Chechen: Оргера тӀом) took place between Chechen Islamists under the command of Ramzan Akhmadov and Ibn al-Khattab and the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation in the early stages of the Second Chechen war for control of the city of Argun. This military operation lasted four days and ended with significant losses for the Russian army.

en.s: On 13 January 2001, at 11:33 CTZ (17:33 UTC), a Mw 7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Usulután Department, El Salvador, at a depth of 60 km (37 mi). At least 952 people were killed; 944 in El Salvador and 8 in Guatemala, over 5,500 were injured and nearly 200 were left missing due to the earthquake; every single department in the country reported casualties and severe damage, and damage from the earthquake was reported in five countries throughout Central America.

zh.s: 2001年1月13日中部标准时间11时33分，即协调世界时17时33分，萨尔瓦多乌苏卢坦省近海发生矩震级7.7级地震，震源深度60公里。至少952人死亡，其中萨尔瓦多944人、危地马拉八人；超过5,500人受伤，近200人失踪。萨尔瓦多所有省份都报告了人员伤亡及严重损坏，中美洲共有五个国家报告地震损失。

en.t: 208996 Achlys was discovered by Chad Trujillo and Michael E. Brown at Palomar Observatory
en.s: 208996 Achlys (provisional designation 2003 AZ84) is a large trans-Neptunian object orbiting the Sun in the Kuiper belt, a region of icy bodies beyond Neptune. It was discovered on 13 January 2003 by Chad Trujillo and Michael E. Brown at Palomar Observatory. Achlys has an elongated shape that is believed to be distorted by its rapid 6.8-hour rotation.

zh.t: 小行星208996号“阿克吕斯”被发现
zh.s: 2003年1月13日，查德·特鲁希略与迈克尔·E.布朗在帕洛马天文台发现小行星208996号“阿克吕斯”，临时编号为2003 AZ84。这是一颗在柯伊伯带绕太阳运行的大型海王星外天体。它的形状细长，据信与约6.8小时的快速自转周期有关。

en.t: Uzbekistan Airways Flight 1154 crashes while landing at Tashkent International Airport, killing 37
en.s: Uzbekistan Airways Flight 1154 (HY1154/UZB1154) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight which was operated by Uzbekistan flag carrier Uzbekistan Airways from Termez Airport in the city of Termez, near the Afghanistan border, to Uzbekistan's capital of Tashkent. On 13 January 2004 the aircraft operating the flight, a Yakovlev Yak-40 registered in Uzbekistan as UK-87985, collided with a radar station while landing at Tashkent, flipped over, caught fire and exploded, killing all 37 people on board.

zh.t: 乌兹别克斯坦航空1154号班机空难
zh.s: 2004年1月13日，乌兹别克斯坦航空1154号班机由靠近阿富汗边境的铁尔梅兹飞往首都塔什干。执飞的雅克-40客机注册号为UK-87985，在塔什干降落时撞上雷达站，随后翻覆、起火并爆炸，机上37人全部遇难。

zh.s: 2008年1月13日，第三届印度尼西亚杯决赛在雅加达朋加诺体育场举行，由斯里维加亚对阵查亚普拉佩尔西普拉。这是斯里维加亚首次进入决赛；佩尔西普拉则连续第二次打进决赛，此前一届曾负于阿雷马。

en.s: The 2011 by-election in Oldham East and Saddleworth was a by-election for the Parliament of the United Kingdom's House of Commons constituency of Oldham East and Saddleworth held on 13 January 2011. Labour Party candidate Debbie Abrahams held the seat for her party with an increased majority over the Liberal Democrats, succeeding Phil Woolas, whose victory in the 2010 general election had been declared void because he had knowingly made false statements attacking his Liberal Democrat opponent's personal character. The contest was the first by-election of the 2010 Parliament, and the first by-election to be caused by an election court overturning the previous result since the 1997 Winchester by-election.

zh.t: 2011年英国奥尔德姆东及萨德尔沃思补选
zh.s: 2011年1月13日，英国奥尔德姆东及萨德尔沃思下议院选区举行补选。工党候选人黛比·亚伯拉罕斯保住议席，并扩大了对自由民主党的领先票数。她接替菲尔·伍拉斯；伍拉斯在2010年大选中的胜利被宣布无效，因为他明知不实，仍发表攻击自由民主党对手个人品格的言论。这是2010届议会的首次补选，也是自1997年温彻斯特补选以来，首次由选举法庭推翻原结果而引发的补选。

en.s: On 13 January 2012, the seven-year-old Costa Cruises vessel Costa Concordia was on the first leg of a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea when the cruise ship deviated from her planned route at Isola del Giglio, Italy in order to perform a sail-by salute, and as a consequence struck a rock formation on the sea floor. This caused the ship to list and then to partially sink, landing unevenly on an underwater ledge. Although a six-hour rescue effort brought most of the passengers ashore, 32 people died: 27 passengers and five crew members.

zh.s: 2012年1月13日，船龄七年的歌诗达邮轮“协和”号，正进行地中海巡航的第一段航程。为在意大利吉廖岛附近贴岸鸣笛致意，邮轮偏离原定航线，撞上海底礁石，随后倾斜并部分沉没，斜停在水下一处岩架上。持续六小时的救援将大多数乘客送上岸，但仍有32人死亡，包括27名乘客及五名船员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 13 January 2012, following two-round parliamentary elections held in October 2011. Incumbent President Anote Tong sought re-election to a third four-year term, ending months of speculation about his decision. Tong beat Tetaua Taitai of the United Coalition Party and Rimeta Beniamina of the Maurin Kiribati Party with a little over 42% of the vote.

zh.s: 继2011年10月两轮议会选举之后，基里巴斯于2012年1月13日举行总统选举。现任总统阿诺特·汤结束了外界数月来对其决定的猜测，参选争取第三个四年任期。他以略高于42%的得票率，击败联合联盟党的泰陶阿·泰泰，以及Maurin Kiribati党的里梅塔·贝尼亚米纳。

en.s: Genesis (2013) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling that was held on January 13, 2013 at the Impact Wrestling Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the eighth annual Genesis event. This was the first pay-per-view event of the 2013 calendar to jump start TNA's new business initiative to reduce their regular annual PPVs a year down to four. Nine matches were featured on the card. In the main event was Jeff Hardy successfully defending the TNA World Heavyweight Championship against Bobby Roode and Austin Aries in a Triple Threat Elimination match.

zh.s: 2013年1月13日，TNA职业摔角联盟在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Wrestling Zone，举办第八届年度“创世纪”按次付费赛事。它是TNA当年的首场按次付费赛事，也开启了新经营安排：把每年常规按次付费赛事减少至四场。赛事共九场，压轴赛是三人淘汰赛，杰夫·哈迪击败博比·鲁德及奥斯汀·阿里斯，成功卫冕TNA世界重量级冠军。

en.t: 2018 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2018 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 13 January 2018. The leadership election was held after then PSD leader Pedro Passos Coelho confirmed he would not run for another term in the aftermath of the poor results of the PSD in the 2017 local elections. Only two candidates came forward: Rui Rio, former mayor of Porto, and Pedro Santana Lopes, former PSD leader, Prime Minister and mayor of Lisbon.
